3200:
** μεμβράνα**, ἡ,
= Latin _membrāna_, **parchment**, {{NT+2nd c.AD+|NT.2Tim.4.13, 2nd c.AD(?): Charax Historicus 14, “POxy.” 2156.9 (4th-5th c.AD)}}:—also **μέμβρανον**, τό, {{Refs 6th c.AD+|6th c.AD: Lydus, Joannes Laurentius Historicus “de Mensibus” 1.28}}: hence _adjective_ **μεμβράϊνος**, {{Refs 6th c.AD+|“PMasp.” 144.6 (6th c.AD)}}, and _substantive_ **μεμβραϊνάριος**, probably in {{Refs 6th c.AD+|“Stud.Pal.” 20.194 (6th c.AD).}}
3202:
** μεμψῐ-μοιρος**, ον,
**faultfinding, criticizing, querulous**, {{NT+5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Isocrates Orator 12.8, 4th-3rd c.BC: Theophrastus Philosophus “Characteres” 17.2, 1st c.BC: Philodemus Philosophus “περὶ παρρησίας” p.42 O., NT.Jude.16, 2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “Tim.” 13, etc.; τὸ μ. 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus 2.50b}}: _comparative_, γυνὴ ἀνδρὸς -ότερον {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Aristoteles Philosophus “Historia Animalium” 608b10.}}
